name: claude-whitebox
description: Claude Code plugins for authorized security testing: white-box source-code audit and black-box penetration testing, for AI threat testing and reconnaissance

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright MCP server with a stealth-friendly default config (real Chrome channel, headed, realistic UA/viewport/locale, anti-automation flags) for browser-driven security testing. Provides the mcp__plugin_playwright_playwright__* tools the pentest plugin's client-side agents depend on.

plugins.name: pentest
plugins.description: Full penetration testing framework - 64 attack categories across 11 domains covering OWASP, injection, authentication, cloud, and more

plugins.name: codeaudit
plugins.description: White-box source code security audit framework - static source-to-sink analysis across 17 vulnerability domains: core 10 (injection, XSS, auth, access control, SSRF, secrets, crypto, dependencies, configuration, logging) plus extended 7 (business logic, feature abuse, data lifecycle/isolation, client-side, HTTP protocol, AI/LLM, resource exhaustion) with optional live correlation

plugins.name: codeaudit-hybride
plugins.description: Dual-engine white-box audit: the unchanged codeaudit pipeline (Claude) plus Codex (via OpenAI's codex-plugin-cc, read-only) as a blind second detector, cross-verifier and false-negative hunter — deterministic reconciliation and agreement-based confidence calibration. Requires the codeaudit plugin.
